_why: Remote / phone-browser paired-device UI had ZERO real captures (completeness-screens.md, 2026-09-23 audit) — the one related shot tested a text fallback inside the desktop app, not the actual phone-side experience. Full login (RemoteGate/LoginScreen, remote-gate.tsx) is structurally unreachable here: index.tsx's dev-only workbench bootstrap renders <App/> directly and explicitly bypasses <Root>/<RemoteGate> (its own comment: 'Root exists only to own remote connection state ... going through Root would mean converting isElectron to a function ... going through Root would break a module-eval-time const') — that gap is real and would need a new dev-only entry point to close, out of this repair's scope. What IS reachable and existing (install-mock.ts declarePlatform, `?connection=remote`, undocumented in the README's switches list but present in source): the PAIRED, POST-login state — platform='browser' + isRemoteMode()=true, everything every isRemoteMode() branch in the shared renderer keys on. Filmed narrow (390) because that is the only width a phone browser has (source comment). Known fidelity gaps stated in source: no wallpaper theme layer, no Unpair button, no real terminal PTY classifier — there is no live remote server behind this, only the flag.
